evidence.quote: Ipca is a 75-year-old (founded 1949) Indian pharmaceutical company that crossed ₹6,749 Cr standalone and ₹9,032 Cr consolidated revenue in FY25 and is on track for ~₹9,646 Cr consolidated in FY26.
It is the 16th largest player in the Indian formulations market (IQVIA MAT March 2026) with 22 marketing divisions and ~174 brands.
It already exports APIs and formulations to 100+ countries and supplies ~40% of US generic formulations and ~25% of UK medicines by volume.
Revenue base is large (TTM ₹9,646 Cr), but growth profile is re-accelerating: consolidated revenue growth picked up to ~8% YoY in FY26 vs prior years.
Profitability is structurally improving: standalone EBITDA margin expanded from 15.31% (FY24) → 18.89% (FY25) → ~25.18% (FY26).
The company's growth has shifted from 'volume + price' to 'complex generics + biosimilars + branded'.
The Hingni greenfield API plant (~₹150 Cr) explicitly aims to reduce dependency on Chinese API imports.
The annual report does not explicitly cite PLI sanction letters or specific benefits drawn.
Ipca ranks 16th in IQVIA's MAT March 2026 ranking for domestic formulations with 2.09% market share.
The company has 18,043 permanent employees (1,129 overseas), 7,000+ medical reps, R&D centres in Mumbai/Ratlam/Silvassa/Vadodara.
